audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar second-census and inheritance text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for post-plague census, tribal clan totals, Korah survival note, daughters of Zelophehad, land-by-lot inheritance, Levite census, and generational transition. Anti-militarization, gender-justice, and anti-human-worth safeguards required.

verses.restored: After the plague, YHWH spoke to Moses and to Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, saying,

familiar.text: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

modern.text: After the plague had ended, the LORD said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron the priest,

original.text: וַיְהִ֖י אַחֲרֵ֣י הַמַּגֵּפָ֑ה

verses.restored: Lift up the head/count all congregation of children of Israel from twenty years old and upward, by houses of their fathers, everyone going out to host in Israel.

familiar.text: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers’ house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.

modern.text: “Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel by the houses of their fathers—all those twenty years of age or older who can serve in the army of Israel.”

original.text: שְׂא֞וּ אֶת רֹ֣אשׁ כָּל עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה וָמַ֖עְלָה לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם כָּל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in plains of Moab by Jordan at Jericho, saying,

familiar.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

modern.text: So on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest issued the instruction,

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֹתָ֖ם בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: From twenty years old and upward, as YHWH commanded Moses and children of Israel who came out from land of Egypt.

familiar.text: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.

modern.text: “Take a census of the men twenty years of age or older, as the LORD has commanded Moses.” And these were the Israelites who came out of the land of Egypt: The Tribe of Reuben

original.text: מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת מֹשֶׁה֙ וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Reuben, firstborn of Israel: sons of Reuben were Hanoch, clan of Hanochites; of Pallu, clan of Palluites;

familiar.text: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

modern.text: Reuben was the firstborn of Israel. These were the descendants of Reuben: The Hanochite clan from Hanoch, the Palluite clan from Pallu,

original.text: רְאוּבֵ֖ן בְּכ֣וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֗ן חֲנוֹךְ֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַחֲנֹכִ֔י לְפַלּ֕וּא מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַפַּלֻּאִֽי

verses.restored: of Hezron, clan of Hezronites; of Carmi, clan of Carmites.

familiar.text: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

modern.text: the Hezronite clan from Hezron, and the Carmite clan from Carmi.

original.text: לְחֶצְרֹ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶצְרוֹנִ֑י לְכַרְמִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַכַּרְמִֽי

verses.restored: These were clans of Reubenites; those counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

familiar.text: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

modern.text: These were the clans of Reuben, and their registration numbered 43,730.

original.text: אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הָרֻֽאוּבֵנִ֑י וַיִּהְי֣וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים

verses.restored: Son of Pallu was Eliab.

familiar.text: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.

modern.text: Now the son of Pallu was Eliab,

original.text: וּבְנֵ֥י פַלּ֖וּא אֱלִיאָֽב

verses.restored: Sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These Dathan and Abiram were summoned ones of congregation who contended against Moses and Aaron in congregation of Korah, when they contended against YHWH.

familiar.text: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:

modern.text: and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. It was Dathan and Abiram, chosen by the congregation, who fought against Moses and Aaron with the followers of Korah who rebelled against the LORD.

original.text: וּבְנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָ֔ב נְמוּאֵ֖ל וְדָתָ֣ן וַאֲבִירָ֑ם הֽוּא דָתָ֨ן וַאֲבִירָ֜ם קרואי הָעֵדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצּ֜וּ עַל מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְעַֽל אַהֲרֹן֙ בַּעֲדַת קֹ֔רַח בְּהַצֹּתָ֖ם עַל יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Earth opened its mouth and swallowed them together with Korah when congregation died, when fire consumed two hundred fifty men; and they became a sign.

familiar.text: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.

modern.text: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire consumed 250 men. They serve as a warning sign.

original.text: וַתִּפְתַּ֨ח הָאָ֜רֶץ אֶת פִּ֗יהָ וַתִּבְלַ֥ע אֹתָ֛ם וְאֶת קֹ֖רַח בְּמ֣וֹת הָעֵדָ֑ה בַּאֲכֹ֣ל הָאֵ֗שׁ אֵ֣ת חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּמָאתַ֨יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וַיִּהְי֖וּ לְנֵֽס

verses.restored: But sons of Korah did not die.

familiar.text: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.

modern.text: However, the line of Korah did not die out. The Tribe of Simeon

original.text: וּבְנֵי קֹ֖רַח לֹא מֵֽתוּ

verses.restored: Sons of Simeon by clans: of Nemuel, clan of Nemuelites; of Jamin, clan of Jaminites; of Jachin, clan of Jachinites;

familiar.text: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

modern.text: These were the descendants of Simeon by their clans: The Nemuelite clan from Nemuel, the Jaminite clan from Jamin, the Jachinite clan from Jachin,

original.text: בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְעוֹן֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לִנְמוּאֵ֗ל מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַנְּמ֣וּאֵלִ֔י לְיָמִ֕ין מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיָּמִינִ֑י לְיָכִ֕ין מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיָּכִינִֽי

verses.restored: of Zerah, clan of Zerahites; of Shaul, clan of Shaulites.

familiar.text: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

modern.text: the Zerahite clan from Zerah, and the Shaulite clan from Shaul.

original.text: לְזֶ֕רַח מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַזַּרְחִ֑י לְשָׁא֕וּל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁאוּלִֽי

verses.restored: These were clans of Simeonites: twenty-two thousand two hundred.

familiar.text: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

modern.text: These were the clans of Simeon, and there were 22,200 men. The Tribe of Gad

original.text: אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַשִּׁמְעֹנִ֑י שְׁנַ֧יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם

verses.restored: Sons of Gad by clans: of Zephon, clan of Zephonites; of Haggi, clan of Haggites; of Shuni, clan of Shunites;

familiar.text: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

modern.text: These were the descendants of Gad by their clans: The Zephonite clan from Zephon, the Haggite clan from Haggi, the Shunite clan from Shuni,

original.text: בְּנֵ֣י גָד֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לִצְפ֗וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַצְּפוֹנִ֔י לְחַגִּ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחַגִּ֑י לְשׁוּנִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשּׁוּנִֽי

verses.restored: of Ozni, clan of Oznites; of Eri, clan of Erites;

familiar.text: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:

modern.text: the Oznite clan from Ozni, the Erite clan from Eri,

original.text: לְאָזְנִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאָזְנִ֑י לְעֵרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָעֵרִֽי

verses.restored: of Arod, clan of Arodites; of Areli, clan of Arelites.

familiar.text: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

modern.text: the Arodite clan from Arod, and the Arelite clan from Areli.

original.text: לַאֲר֕וֹד מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאֲרוֹדִ֑י לְאַ֨רְאֵלִ֔י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאַרְאֵלִֽי

verses.restored: These were clans of sons of Gad according to those counted of them: forty thousand five hundred.

familiar.text: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

modern.text: These were the clans of Gad, and their registration numbered 40,500. The Tribe of Judah

original.text: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵֽי גָ֖ד לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת

verses.restored: Sons of Judah were Er and Onan, and Er and Onan died in land of Canaan.

familiar.text: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

modern.text: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan, but they died in the land of Canaan.

original.text: בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה עֵ֣ר וְאוֹנָ֑ן וַיָּ֥מָת עֵ֛ר וְאוֹנָ֖ן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן

verses.restored: Sons of Judah by clans were: of Shelah, clan of Shelanites; of Perez, clan of Perezites; of Zerah, clan of Zerahites.

familiar.text: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.

modern.text: These were the descendants of Judah by their clans: The Shelanite clan from Shelah, the Perezite clan from Perez, and the Zerahite clan from Zerah.

original.text: וַיִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵי יְהוּדָה֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְשֵׁלָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַשֵּׁ֣לָנִ֔י לְפֶ֕רֶץ מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַפַּרְצִ֑י לְזֶ֕רַח מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַזַּרְחִֽי

verses.restored: Sons of Perez were: of Hezron, clan of Hezronites; of Hamul, clan of Hamulites.

familiar.text: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

modern.text: And these were the descendants of Perez: the Hezronite clan from Hezron and the Hamulite clan from Hamul.

original.text: וַיִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵי פֶ֔רֶץ לְחֶצְרֹ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶצְרֹנִ֑י לְחָמ֕וּל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הֶחָמוּלִֽי

verses.restored: These were clans of Judah according to those counted of them: seventy-six thousand five hundred.

familiar.text: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.

modern.text: These were the clans of Judah, and their registration numbered 76,500. The Tribe of Issachar

original.text: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת יְהוּדָ֖ה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת

verses.restored: Sons of Issachar by clans: Tola, clan of Tolaites; of Puvah, clan of Punites;

familiar.text: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:

modern.text: These were the descendants of Issachar by their clans: The Tolaite clan from Tola, the Punite clan from Puvah,

original.text: בְּנֵ֤י יִשָּׂשכָר֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם תּוֹלָ֕ע מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַתּוֹלָעִ֑י לְפֻוָ֕ה מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַפּוּנִֽי

verses.restored: of Jashub, clan of Jashubites; of Shimron, clan of Shimronites.

familiar.text: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

modern.text: the Jashubite clan from Jashub, and the Shimronite clan from Shimron.

original.text: לְיָשׁ֕וּב מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיָּשׁוּבִ֑י לְשִׁמְרֹ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁמְרֹנִֽי

verses.restored: These were clans of Issachar according to those counted of them: sixty-four thousand three hundred.

familiar.text: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.

modern.text: These were the clans of Issachar, and their registration numbered 64,300. The Tribe of Zebulun

original.text: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת

verses.restored: Sons of Zebulun by clans: of Sered, clan of Seredites; of Elon, clan of Elonites; of Jahleel, clan of Jahleelites.

familiar.text: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

modern.text: These were the descendants of Zebulun by their clans: The Seredite clan from Sered, the Elonite clan from Elon, and the Jahleelite clan from Jahleel.

original.text: בְּנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻן֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְסֶ֗רֶד מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַסַּרְדִּ֔י לְאֵל֕וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאֵלֹנִ֑י לְיַ֨חְלְאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַיַּחְלְאֵלִֽי

verses.restored: These were clans of Zebulunites according to those counted of them: sixty thousand five hundred.

familiar.text: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.

modern.text: These were the clans of Zebulun, and their registration numbered 60,500. The Tribe of Manasseh

original.text: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַזְּבוּלֹנִ֖י לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת

verses.restored: Sons of Joseph by clans were Manasseh and Ephraim.

familiar.text: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.

modern.text: The descendants of Joseph included the clans of Manasseh and Ephraim.

original.text: בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְאֶפְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Sons of Manasseh: of Machir, clan of Machirites; Machir fathered Gilead; of Gilead, clan of Gileadites.

familiar.text: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.

modern.text: These were the descendants of Manasseh: The Machirite clan from Machir, the father of Gilead, and the Gileadite clan from Gilead.

original.text: בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לְמָכִיר֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמָּכִירִ֔י וּמָכִ֖יר הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת גִּלְעָ֑ד לְגִלְעָ֕ד מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַגִּלְעָדִֽי

familiar.text: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

modern.text: These were the descendants of Gilead: the Iezerite clan from Iezer, the Helekite clan from Helek,

original.text: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד אִיעֶ֕זֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָאִֽיעֶזְרִ֑י לְחֵ֕לֶק מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽחֶלְקִֽי

verses.restored: of Asriel, clan of Asrielites; of Shechem, clan of Shechemites;

familiar.text: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

modern.text: the Asrielite clan from Asriel, the Shechemite clan from Shechem,

original.text: וְאַ֨שְׂרִיאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽאַשְׂרִֽאֵלִ֑י וְשֶׁ֕כֶם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁכְמִֽי

verses.restored: of Shemida, clan of Shemidaites; of Hepher, clan of Hepherites.

familiar.text: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

modern.text: the Shemidaite clan from Shemida, and the Hepherite clan from Hepher.

original.text: וַיִּהְי֣וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף כָּל זָכָ֖ר מִבֶּן חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה כִּ֣י לֹ֣א הָתְפָּקְד֗וּ בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י לֹא נִתַּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: These were those counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted children of Israel in plains of Moab by Jordan at Jericho.

familiar.text: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

modern.text: These were the ones numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho.

original.text: אֵ֚לֶּה פְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּֽקְד֜וּ אֶת בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ

verses.restored: Among these there was not a man from those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted children of Israel in wilderness of Sinai.

familiar.text: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

modern.text: Among all these, however, there was not one who had been numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Wilderness of Sinai.

original.text: וּבְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ לֹא הָ֣יָה אִ֔ישׁ מִפְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקְד֛וּ אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי

verses.restored: For YHWH had said of them, They shall surely die in wilderness. Not one of them remained except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

familiar.text: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

modern.text: For the LORD had told them that they would surely die in the wilderness. Not one was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

original.text: כִּֽי אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם מ֥וֹת יָמֻ֖תוּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְלֹא נוֹתַ֤ר מֵהֶם֙ אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֚י אִם כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נֽוּן

translation_notes: The second census marks generational transition after the wilderness deaths; it is not a ranking of human worth.
Military-age language remains descriptive of ancient camp organization and must not define belonging, masculinity, disability, or value.
Numbers 26:11 explicitly states that sons of Korah did not die, qualifying broad household language in Numbers 16.
The daughters of Zelophehad are named within the census before their legal petition in chapter 27, preserving women's presence in the inheritance story.
Land allocation combines proportional population size with lot, balancing need and tribal inheritance tradition.
Levites are counted separately because their inheritance structure differs, not because they are superior.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 26 to value people by military capacity, male lineage, fertility, tribe, or census inclusion. The chapter records a changing generation and prepares an inheritance system that will soon be challenged and expanded by named women.
